name: pbt-guard
description: The calculation engine is the product. Any edit under lib/calc must keep the property suite green.

then.prompt: Run `npx vitest run lib/calc` and report the result. If a property test fails, the engine is wrong — fix lib/calc, never weaken the property. If you changed a constant, say which constant and why. Do not add example-based tests to paper over a failing property.
